reviews.review: Probably the best military oriented FPS franchise. If you like tactical gameplay you shoud definately try ArmA 3 out.

EA and DICE, you should be ashamed of yourselves, letting another game take Battlefields spot. This is the next big thing in FPS teamwork and sandbox gaming. 

Too bad guys, you spent too much time pandering to hardware that is more concerned with TV and BlueRay than games, making your games smaller so they run on outdated hardware with poor control systems and pooping on the people who bought you your Ferraris. Bohemia Interactive has taken the reins and taken the lead. You should have seen this coming with Arma2, especialy after DayZ. Bohemia Interactive already has my money and where is BF4... Not in my games library. 

Arma3 is the AAA title you should buy. Don't waste your money on Battlefield X or Call of Duty X, this is what you want right here. Once you buy this you will dig in and not look up at all the crap that is being pooped out, packaged and sold at a premium price. Arma3 is priced at $59.99 or $64.99 for the Digital Deluxe Edition (or if you want my recomendation, go straight to the Bohemia Interactive website and support them directly by buying the Supporter Edition) you can't go wrong. Drop some cash on this and you wont need or want to spend your money on anything FPS until the next Arma3 content release. 

See you on the islands. 

Edited for price changes as it was written during Beta.

ARMA has persisted through its many iterations as a game that focuses on warfare and simulates It to a very realistic level.  I have reasons to like and dislike the game it has a fairly steep learning curve, but asking for help will usually yield decent results due to a active community.  In my opinion the game has a bit of work needed in the field of optimization and server stability however beyond those two things the game is relatively strong in most areas.

Other than that i would recommend this game to anyone who was a fan of the Operation Flash-point games and is looking for a good open world military simulator.

1,358 hour edit: This game has evolved greatly from the alpha (around the time the above was written) into a high quality military simulator one of the great things about this game is its mod support and mission making aspects.  This is great when combined with an active community and this game has just that.  The best part of the modability is that mods range from anything as silly as swapping bullets for rabbits, to mods that revamp almost all game mechanics to make an ultra realistic and difficult expirience.

2 Years have past since I posted the original review and I would say the same thing now; I recommend this game to anyone who was a fan of the Operation flashpoint games and is looking for a great and challenging expirience.

Yet another update... at almost 2000 hours this game still provides amazing gameplay and new things to do through modding, this game just keeps on going.
